■Direction
Gets knocked back and digs heels in

(...The front is completely boxed in... but
as long as I do what I always do, I'll be fine. All right, let's do this!!)

Where Biko Pegasus's gaze fell—all the runners in this race
were blessed with massive builds. It reminded me of that one mock race.

Hey, Trainer.
...You did something amazing too, you know.

(What do I do, I can't see an opening!
With my size, if I try to force my way in, I'll just get knocked back again!)

The gap she tried to slip through vanishes in an instant.
Amidst the fierce jostling, Biko Pegasus's small frame is forced out—

Ahaha, just kidding! Of course it's fine!!
Our united front continues!!

That's why—I decided to say what I hadn't been able to say,
what I hadn't found the resolve for all this time.
(I can stand right back up, no matter how many times it takes!!)
—It starts now!!
...I totally felt like we'd already been contracted this whole time...!
...Thank you so, so much!! My hero!!
...Huh?
It was the very image of the hero that first captivated me.

I wanted to help her pull through somehow, but there was no time left before the race.
All I could do was support her like I always did.
Here I gooo!! Pegasus Mach—

(If only I could run like Brian-san...
But I'm—)

(If Brian-san was in a spot like this...
she'd probably push forward all at once with that massive stride of hers.)

(Yeah, that's it. That's my "usual self"!
Even if my stride falls short, even if I get knocked away—)
I did it~~~~!! I did it, I did it!! Yay~~!!

Even when I was moping around, you kept cheering me on the whole time.
You never gave up either, Trainer! So that's why—
That's right, the real battle—
...? Yeah!
Yeah!! So listen, Trainer!!

Wha...!? Wh-What are you saying?!
The race is right around the corner, you know?! As if I'd let that bother me!
What is it, Trainer?!
Let's become one-of-a-kind tag-team heroes together!!

...Ah, everyone's already gathering!
Well then, I'm heading out, Trainer!

I received courage. I gave courage back. And now,
being called a hero... I was given courage once again.

I had thought Biko Pegasus was cool from the very beginning.
She didn't need to be overpowering, nor did she need to force a frontal breakthrough.

Towering before her was what you could call a gigantic gate.
Crashing head-on into those tightly shut doors would not end well.

Yet she doesn't stop. For just a tiny moment,
that crack opens up—and she pierces right through it with pure courage.

The Trainer who gave courage to the hero Biko Pegasus
is already a magnificent hero themselve~s!!

(This isn't my "usual self"... These opponents
are way bigger and stronger than the ones in the mock race...!)

—No change at the front as the pack bunches up into Turn 3!
Biko Pegasus stumbles hard, but is she all right?!

(I couldn't... get through...!?
I managed to dig my heels in, but I could've easily wiped out right there...)
—Kh?!
As if I'd let it... ...haah.

Pumping her legs frantically with her small frame,
she confronts huge rivals with everything she's got.

A small feeling of inferiority that had only just sprouted.
It's an emotion felt by so many competitors, and that's precisely why it runs so deep.
(I won't give up... I'm...)

—The day of the event-specific competition.
Biko Pegasus is in great shape! In great shape... and yet—

Thank youuu!! Hehe, Trainer...
You were calling me cool during the race too, weren't you? I heard you!
You're the one who gave me courage!!

Without looking aside for a single second,
Biko Pegasus dives straight into the leading pack.

"No matter how many times I fail, ...
I'll fight to the very end for justice and everyone's health!!"

—That's the leading pack tightly bunched together!
Biko Pegasus is tracking right behind them!
I won't let you through...!!
(I see. That's what—makes a true hero.)
Kh, ugh...!
